heading: Campaign receipts
intro: Har campaign ek receipt ki tarah chhapti hai: kahan chali, maqsad kya tha aur jo figures maine darj kiye. Jo darj nahi, woh nazar nahi aata.
no_figures: Is campaign ke figures publish nahi kiye gaye.
recorded_note: Figures wahi hain jo maine darj kiye.
empty: Campaign receipts yahan tab nazar aayengi jab main unhein shamil karunga.
